newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Amgen rated market performer.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Amgen rated market performer.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it initiated coverage of Amgen Inc, a biological products company, with a market performer rating for the six- and 18-month periods.

-- It said Amgen's two major products, Epogen and Neupogen, generate nearly $2 billion in revenues, though their sales growth is slowing. "We expect new clinical practice guidelines for the use of Epogen to accelerate this slow down in revenues," EVEREN said in a report.
-- Its earnings estimates are $2.41 for FY96 and $2.71 for FY97.
